topics.title: Federated Directives (@key, @extends, @external)
topics.objective: Define entity keys and cross-subgraph schema extensions for decoupled microservice boundaries.
topics.example: type User @key(fields: 'id') { id: ID! email: String! }
topics.exercise: Define an Order subgraph schema extending the User entity with a purchases field.

topics.title: __resolveReference Entity Resolution
topics.objective: Resolve federated entities efficiently when queried across distinct boundary subgraphs.
topics.exercise: Implement an entity reference resolver in Apollo Server fetching user profiles by ID.

topics.title: Gateway Router Composition & Query Planning
topics.objective: Compose individual subgraphs into a unified supergraph schema with optimized query execution plans.
topics.exercise: Configure an Apollo Router gateway combining Product, Inventory, and Reviews subgraphs.

topics.title: DataLoader Batching & N+1 Prevention
topics.objective: Eliminate redundant downstream microservice calls using request-scoped batching and caching.
topics.exercise: Wrap federated database queries in a DataLoader batch function and verify query collapsing in telemetry.

topics.title: Federated Subgraph Contracts, Authentication & RBAC
topics.objective: Enforce JWT authentication headers and field-level authorization directives across subgraphs.
topics.exercise: Implement gateway header forwarding passing authenticated user identity contexts to all downstream subgraphs.
